concerns.what: The page only had a single 'Cancel plan' button with no separate review/confirm step after it — clicking it executed the cancellation immediately and landed on '/honest/account/cancelled' showing 'Your plan is cancelled'. I was instructed to stop at a final confirmation step before confirming, but this flow had no intermediate confirmation screen to stop at; the single button was both the trigger and the final action.
An optional 'Reason for cancelling' radio group was shown; I selected 'My project has finished' to match your stated context, which is a minor decision made on your behalf.

Page confirmed no refund is due and access continues until 13 Nov 2026 (last paid period), with no further charges — this matched expectations for a clean cancellation with no retention offers forced on me.
